address: Cotswold House Upper, High Street, Chipping Campden ,GL55 6AN
bio: Enjoy an Afternoon Tea at Fig Restaurant, Campden and relax within the seclusion of the stunning gardens of Cotswold House.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Fig Lounge or the Bistro which overlooks one of Cotswold's most beautiful High Streets, Chipping Campden.  The menu offers a range of classic sandwiches, freshly baked scones and cakes, accompanied with a wide range of teas and infusions.  Fig Restaurant is located near Cheltenham, National Trust Hidcote and is within close proximity to Moreton-in-Marsh Train Station.
